spells/repair-critical-damage-3808.name: Repair Critical Damage
spells/repair-critical-damage-3808.effectSummary: By touching one construct that has at least 1 hit point remaining, instantly repairs 4d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level, maximum +20. The spell inherits Repair Light Damage's construct-only and minimum-1-hit-point applicability; it changes only the amount repaired. It has no saving throw and allows harmless spell resistance.
spells/repair-critical-damage-3808.notes: Source-locked to Dragon Compendium. The same printing confirms Repair Light Damage as 1d8 despite an OCR-like 'ld8' rendering in some catalog text; Repair Critical Damage itself clearly prints 4d8 +1/level, maximum +20.

spells/repair-critical-damage-mass-3809.effectSummary: Instantly repairs 4d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level, maximum +40, to each selected construct.
